Hair care

Keep your crown looking fresh

Simple habits that help your style last longer and keep your natural hair healthy.

Braids

Moisturise your scalp and wrap your hair in a satin scarf or bonnet at night. Most braids are best taken down within six to eight weeks to protect your natural hair.

Crochet pieces

Hand wash your crochet hats and bags in cool water with mild soap, then dry them flat so they keep their shape.

Wigs

Store your wig on a stand or head form, detangle gently from the ends up, and wash it regularly with sulphate-free products.

Your natural hair

Give your edges a break between protective styles and keep your hair moisturised underneath every install.

Questions

Good to know

Where are you located?

Crownify operates online. Book with us on WhatsApp and we will confirm all the details of your appointment with you directly.

How much does a style cost?

Prices depend on the style, size and length you choose. Send us a photo of the look you want on WhatsApp and we will give you a quote.

Do I need to bring my own hair?

Let us know when you book. We will tell you the type and amount of hair your style needs and advise you on the options.

How long does braiding take?

It depends on the braid size, length and style. Smaller, longer braids take more time. We will give you an estimate when you book.

Can you make a wig to my measurements?

Yes. Custom wig making means your unit is made to fit you. Message us to discuss the length, texture and style you want.

Can you fix or restyle my old wig?

Yes, we offer wig revamping and restyling. Send us a photo of your wig on WhatsApp so we can advise.

Do you make crochet items to order?

Yes. Tell us the item, colours and size you want, or send a photo for inspiration, and we will let you know the price and when it will be ready.

How do I book?

Use the booking form on this page or tap any WhatsApp button. Your message opens ready to send.
